messages.content: "你能告訴我分子ATP在具有特定功能的細胞器粒線體中的作用是什麼嗎？然後計算從紐約到洛杉磯的最短駕駛距離（以英里為單位），接著，你能告訴我誰是相對論的發現者，最後，你能告訴我Fender的Stratocaster如果是太陽紋的漆面的零售價格是多少嗎？"

function.name: get_shortest_driving_distance
function.description: Calculate the shortest driving distance between two locations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit.description: Preferred unit of distance (optional, default is kilometers).

function.description: Look up the function of a given molecule in a specified organelle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

specific_function.description: If set to true, a specific function of the molecule within the organelle will be provided, if such information exists.
